title: Surface-Driven Stochastic Volatility for Commodity Options: Identification of Stochastic Vol-of-Vol and Leverage from Smile Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.27138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Commodity option surfaces contain information beyond the at-the-money volatility level. We develop a surface-driven stochastic-volatility framework for soybean futures options using daily Chicago Mercantile Exchange Group Volatility Index (CME CVOL) indicators from October 2013 to August 2025. The ATM level and convexity are positive, right-skewed, and well described by log Ornstein Uhlenbeck dynamics, whereas the additive skew changes sign and is modeled on the real line by an Ornstein Uhlenbeck process. These empirical features motivate a joint mean-reverting surface-factor system. Under a log OU futures volatility model, leading-order smile relations map the ATM level to the latent volatility state, convexity to an effective surface-implied volatility- of-volatility state, and skew to an effective leverage state. translated_title: 基于曲面驱动的商品期权随机波动率模型：从微笑动态中识别随机波动率的波动率与杠杆
translated_abstract: 商品期权波动率曲面包含超出平值（ATM）波动率水平的信息。我们利用2013年10月至2025年8月芝加哥商品交易所集团波动率指数（CME CVOL）的日度指标，为大豆期货期权开发了一个曲面驱动的随机波动率框架。ATM水平与凸性为正值、呈右偏分布，可以很好地用对数Ornstein-Uhlenbeck动力学来描述，而加性偏度会发生符号变化，因此用实数线上的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程建模。这些实证特征促成了一个联合均值回归的曲面因子系统。在对数OU期货波动率模型下，低阶微笑关系将ATM水平映射为潜在波动率状态，将凸性映射为有效的曲面隐含波动率的波动率（vol-of-vol）状态，将偏度映射为有效的杠杆状态。我们推导了相应的风险中性定价方程与Feynman-Kac表示，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟对价格进行了基准验证……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于期权曲面驱动的随机波动率框架，利用大豆期货期权的微笑动态，将ATM水平、凸性和偏度分别识别为潜在波动率、随机波动率的波动率与杠杆三个状态变量，并据此推导定价方程。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a surface-driven stochastic volatility framework for soybean futures options that identifies latent volatility, stochastic vol-of-vol, and leverage states from smile dynamics (ATM level, convexity, and skew) and derives the associated risk-neutral pricing equation.
